Spec: sidebar groups a workspace by its work in progress — UI atlas

Spec: sidebar groups a workspace by its work in progress — UI atlas

3 views with 6 states. Mocked: Placement options. The remaining areas are listed from the map and are not designed yet.

Illustrative only. Low-fi wireframes on the app’s tokens: they decide anatomy, states and copy intent, not the final look. All names and data are fictional. Card text is rendered from the cards files and the view list from spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-map.md: change the markdown and regenerate. Link to a view or a state by id: #A1, #A1-s2.

Compared with today’s app

Paseo FSH fork fsh at ae781d529 (2026-11-25), with Overview's In progress section (#237) and paseo-asks inProgress entries (#91).

The sidebar today:

  • Groups, top to bottom: Needs input, Failed, Ready to review, Working, Done, Blocked. An idle workspace goes to Ready to review when its last turn finished, unless a plugin report moves it: paseo-status's card (Working, Blocked, Done; a Working card counts only while something ran in the last 5 minutes) or paseo-asks' open asks (needs you → Ready to review).
  • Workspace row: title, project, and a line of badges: "needs you (3)" from open asks, plugin badges, the time since last activity. A spinning ring while running.
  • In-progress asks count nowhere in the sidebar; only Overview's In progress section lists them.

3 new views. Inside frames, while Changes is on: new changed removed (removed parts show only then).

Placement options — area rules

source: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Area-wide

  • Purpose. Compare three groups for an idle workspace whose open work is all in progress and moving. Every option is drawn on the same sidebar, so frames with the same state id compare directly.
  • Sidebar. Seven workspaces in one project: "Fix login redirect" (an agent asks a permission → Needs input), "Track: Billing pages" (the one in question: turn ended, 3 asks wait on CI and review, a merge queue runs, nothing waits on you), "Track: Search" (asks you to name a tab → Ready to review), "Docs: release notes" (agent running → Working), "Track: Catalog" (5 asks in progress, 2 with nothing moving them), "Upgrade Expo" (Done), "Schema: relations" (Blocked on another workspace).
  • Device. Desktop sidebar, ~300 px wide, light theme as in the Overview atlas.
  • Rows. As today: status ring or dot, title, project, a badge line ("needs you (2)") and the time since last activity.
  • Permissions. None.

V1 Working

newP12 states · Desktop sidebar · 300card text: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

A workspace whose in-progress work is all moving groups under Working.

Change

New.

Extended

"Track: Billing pages" sits under Working next to "Docs: release notes", whose agent runs. Its row has no spinning ring (nothing of its own runs a turn) and its badge line says "3 in progress". "Track: Catalog", with 2 asks nothing moves, stays in Ready to review and says "2 not moving" in the warning tone.

Get here

The sidebar.

Shows

The seven rows in their groups; the Billing row under Working with "3 in progress".

Variants

All seven workspaces; the Billing PRs' CI finishes and two asks go stuck (the row moves to Ready to review with "2 not moving").

Edge cases

A merge queue job still running keeps the row under Working even after the asks are resolved; it leaves when the job ends.

V2 Blocked

newP12 states · Desktop sidebar · 300card text: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

A workspace whose in-progress work is all moving groups under Blocked.

Change

New.

Extended

Blocked already means "waits on something other than you: other workspaces, a reviewer, CI". "Track: Billing pages" joins "Schema: relations" there, at the bottom of the sidebar, with "3 in progress". "Track: Catalog" stays in Ready to review with "2 not moving".

Get here

The sidebar.

Shows

The seven rows; Billing under Blocked, last group.

Variants

All seven workspaces; two of Billing's asks go stuck (the row moves to Ready to review).

Edge cases

Blocked can be collapsed past its limit like Done, so the row may be hidden until you expand the group.

V3 Stays in Ready to review

newP12 states · Desktop sidebar · 300card text: spec-sidebar-in-progress-ui-placement.md

Short

No group change; the row's badge line tells moving work apart from work that needs you.

Change

New.

Extended

"Track: Billing pages" stays in Ready to review with a muted "3 in progress" badge and no "needs you". "Track: Search" next to it says "needs you (1)"; "Track: Catalog" says "2 not moving" in the warning tone. Reading the badges is how you tell them apart.

Get here

The sidebar.

Shows

The seven rows; three under Ready to review with different badges.

Variants

All seven workspaces; two of Billing's asks go stuck (badge turns to "2 not moving").

Edge cases

Move to Done from the row menu still moves it, as today.
